snippet.title: Encounter  - September 2025 trailer
snippet.description:
"Encounter" is a retro adventure game for the Oric computers. It has been made available to PC players thanks to a bundled emulator/launcher.

The game is available on Steam (https://store.steampowered.com/app/3319780/Encounter) and Itch (https://defenceforce.itch.io/encounter)

See http://encounter.defence-force.org for more information about the game
